content: Kawoy Ooziyani hayqida laythi Goday dhoqa araataninne boncho bessan uttidaysa be7as; iya ma7oy Xoossa keethaa kumis.
Surafeela geetetiya kiitanchoti iyape bollara de7oosona; issi issi kiitanchuwas usupun qefeti de7oosona; nam7u qefetan ba som7uwa kammees; nam7u qefetan ba tohuwa kammees; nam7u qefetan piradhees.
Enti issoy issuwako, “Geeshshay, geeshshay, geeshshay, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Godaa! Sa7a ubbay iya bonchuwan kumis” yaagosona.
Enta girsa waasuwa gaason Xoossa keethaa baasoy qaaxis; Xoossa keethay cuyan kumis.
Yaatin, “Taani mettershay tunida asaa giddon de7ayis; ta mettershayka tuna. Taani Kawa, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Godaa ta ayfen be7ida gisho, tana ayye! Ta dhayas!” yaagas.
He kiitanchotape issoy yarsho bessaafe bonqo tama qaphera ekidi piradhishe taako yis.
Bonqo taman ta mettersha bochidi, “Heko; ha bonqo tamay ne mettershay bochida gisho ne naaqoy neepe kichis; ne nagaray atto geetetis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye Goday, “Oona kiitto? Nuus oone baanay?” yaagishin si7as. Taani, “Heko, tana kiitta, taani baana” yaagas.
Goday taako, “Bada ha asaa, ‘Hinte sissi si7eeta, shin akeekeketa; hinte xeelleta, shin demmeketa’ ” yaagada oda.

Kaallidika, “Ha asaa wozanaa muumisa; enta haythaa tullisa; enta ayfiya gooza. Hessi hanonna ixiko, enti banta ayfiyan be7idi, banta haythan si7idi, banta wozanan akeekidi, taako simmana; zaaridi paxana” yaagis.
Taani, “Abeeti Godaw, hessi hananay awude gakanaasee?” yaagas. I zaaridi, “Katamati laaletana gakanaw, keethati kaysa gidana gakanaw, biittay polo dogetana gakanaw;
asaa haaho bessi yeddana gakanawunne biittay asi bayna mela biitta gidana gakanaasa.
Tammu asaape issi asi biitta bolla attiko, ika dhayana. Qanxin attida wolanne caca duruma mela gidana; he durumay geeshsha koche gidana” yaagis.
